verses.text: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.

segments.text: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation,
I have cried day and night before thee.

verses.text: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.

segments.text: Let my prayer enter into thy presence;
Incline thine ear unto my cry.

verses.text: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.

segments.text: For my soul is full of troubles,
And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.

verses.text: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,

segments.text: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit;
I am as a man that hath no help,

verses.text: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.

segments.text: Cast off among the dead,
Like the slain that lie in the grave,
Whom thou rememberest no more,
And they are cut off from thy hand.

verses.text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

segments.text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit,
In dark places, in the deeps.

verses.text: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. [Selah

segments.text: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me,
And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. [Selah

verses.text: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

segments.text: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me;
Thou hast made me an abomination unto them:
I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.text: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.

segments.text: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction:
I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah;
I have spread forth my hands unto thee.

verses.text: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are deceased arise and praise thee? [Selah

segments.text: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead?
Shall they that are deceased arise and praise thee? [Selah

verses.text: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?

segments.text: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave?
Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?

verses.text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

segments.text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark?
And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.text: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.

segments.text: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried;
And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.

verses.text: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?

segments.text: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul?
Why hidest thou thy face from me?

verses.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

segments.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up:
While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

verses.text: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

segments.text: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me;
Thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.text: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.

segments.text: They came round about me like water all the day long;
They compassed me about together.

verses.text: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.

segments.text: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me,
And mine acquaintance into darkness.

headings.text: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
